intro: Если бы + past presents a condition that was not fulfilled; то + бы expresses the hypothetical result.

bloques.titulo: Если бы + past presents a condition that was not fulfilled; то + бы expresses the hypothetical result.
texto: Если бы + past presents a condition that was not fulfilled; то + бы expresses the hypothetical result.
It may be omitted from us or be shown next to the verb of the result; the sense remains countercurrent.

frases.ru: Если бы редактор заметил ошибку, статью бы исправили раньше.
frases.es: Si el editor hubiera detectado el error, habrían corregido antes el artículo.
frases.en: If the editor had detected the error, they would have corrected the article before.

frases.ru: При другой погоде экспедиция состоялась бы.
frases.es: Con otro tiempo, la expedición habría tenido lugar.
frases.en: With another time, the expedition would have taken place.

opciones.explicacion: Бы presents the event as possible in an imagined situation.
This form does not express the relationship that the question calls for.
Check which word rules the case or the structure.
